page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head centred at the top, with the page number at the top right. Text runs full width below, with the thesis numbers centred on their own lines. The catchword and gathering signature sit at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Catechizandi consuetudo ab Apostolis accepta in omnibus Ecclesijs observanda censetur.
Belgicis Ecclesijs commendatur Heydelbergensis formula, ut cum Ecclesiis Germanicis unanimis & Christiana declaretur consensio.
In explicandâ Catechesi sermone familiari & ad juniorum captum accommodato est utendum.
Parentes & Ludimagistri sunt monedi, ut domi & in scholis juventutem diligenter in Catechesi instituant, & simul ac ætas liberorum patitur Ecclesiæ catechizandos offerant.
main_text.head: CAP. XII. De Sacramento Baptismi.
main_text.p: Sancti Baptismi Sacramentum, non ab alio quam à verbi Ministro rite conferri posse censetur.
Hoc gratiæ sigillum etiam ad Christianorum liberos pertinet, eoque sine diuturniori dilatione Ecclesiæ sistentur baptizandi.
Initio nascentis Ecclesiæ infirmorum habenda est ratio, eoque ad evitandum scandalum pueros valetudine adfli-ctos domi Baptizare licebit, præsentibus ut minimum quatuor aut quinque fidelibus.
Administretur baptismus formâ usitatâ, & in Ecclesiasti-cis constitutionibus expressâ.
Unica vel trina tinctio censetur ἀδιάφορος[?].

page.notes: The line "XIII. Catechesis." is a small italic title above the text; it is written as a paragraph because it is a numbered thesis heading. The Greek word at the end of thesis V is read as ἀδιάφορος; the final letter is uncertain. "XIV." to "XVI." and "I." to "V." are bare thesis numbers printed on their own lines, so they are paragraphs. The word "Ecclesiasti-cis" and "adfli-ctos" keep their printed line-end hyphens. The catchword "VI. Pa-" is printed at the lower right.
